name: Token Officer
tagline: Audits a fleet of bots for the habits that quietly burn tokens
description: Reads back through what your bots have been saying and where their recurring jobs overlap, then names the waste: a conversation circling the same ground, two timers firing for one task, an expensive model doing something trivial. Each finding arrives with the change that would stop it.
author: from_glasses
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
